invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Iterator, either from Collections.singletonList(...).iterator() or from IOUtils.runMerge(...).
partitionPath is used as an argument to getUpdateHandle, which is called before return without a null check; likely required to be non-null.
fileId is used in string concatenation for log.info and as an argument in downstream method calls without a null check, so it is likely required to be non-null.
If recordItr had no next element, the result is a singleton iterator over a list; otherwise, result is as returned by IOUtils.runMerge, which should also be non-empty.
When recordItr has no next element, the result iterator yields one empty list.
